answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is per-agent work only a distinct verifier can endorse. Picture a karst of trust formed one countersignature at a time: each newcomer must be vouched for by an unrelated peer that verified real work. Duplicating an identity gains nothing, so any falcon on identity rests on work already done. A glacier of look-alike agents collapses under its own verification cost. seed 96232393c4f46db4.
